environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB with no WAF association. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No session management middleware or proxy-level session controls are configured. The service is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB (internet-facing), no WAF
config.network: Public subnet, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
config.tls: ALB-terminated, HTTP between ALB and container
